config.root_role: repo-wide source maps for validators and generated companions
config.route_local_to: mechanics/<slug>/parts/<part>/config/ when the input belongs to one mechanic operation
config.use_for: repo-wide source maps that drive builders, validators, and route-card companions

examples.root_role: public shared memory-object, lifecycle, provenance, and recall examples
examples.route_local_to: mechanics/<slug>/parts/<part>/examples/ when the example teaches one mechanic contract
examples.use_for: public-safe shared memory examples, recall contracts, and generated-surface manifests

generated.root_role: public compact companions for repo-wide memory, object, route-card, mechanic, and Questbook surfaces
generated.route_local_to: mechanics/<slug>/parts/<part>/generated/ when the output mirrors one mechanic operation
generated.use_for: compact companions consumed outside one package

manifests.root_role: reserved for future shared recurrence manifests
manifests.route_local_to: mechanics/<slug>/parts/<part>/manifests/ when the manifest binds one mechanic operation

schemas.root_role: public shared memory object, recall, provenance, and generated-surface schemas
schemas.route_local_to: mechanics/<slug>/parts/<part>/schemas/ when the schema governs one mechanic operation
schemas.use_for: public memory-object, recall, provenance, support-object, and generated-surface contracts

scripts.root_role: repo-wide validators, index builders, and shared memory-object generators
scripts.route_local_to: mechanics/<slug>/parts/<part>/scripts/ when the entrypoint belongs to one mechanic operation
scripts.use_for: repo-wide validators, builders, release gates, and shared helper modules

tests.root_role: repo-wide regression coverage for shared surfaces, generated parity, route maps, and cross-mechanic contracts
tests.route_local_to: mechanics/<slug>/parts/<part>/tests/ when the test protects one mechanic operation
tests.use_for: repo-wide regressions, route-card coverage, generated parity, and cross-mechanic contracts

placement_rule.root: shared, repo-wide, public contract, generated companion, or cross-mechanic artifact
